economic_hypothesis: Two consecutive legally tradable upper-limit closes after at least sixty sessions without an upper-limit close indicate that new information has not cleared at an unconstrained price. Requiring at least one of the two sessions to trade two percent or more below its upper limit demonstrates actual supply testing rather than two untradeable one-price boards.

frozen_signal.signal: second of two consecutive completed legal upper-limit closes
frozen_signal.upper_limit_comparison: raw-price tick equality to registered daily upper limit
frozen_signal.minimum_supply_test: on at least one of the two upper-limit sessions, raw low <= 98% of registered upper-limit price
frozen_signal.prior_history: twenty completed same-symbol sessions all hard-valid, tradable, market-rule-valid, and corporate-action-valid
frozen_signal.coordinate_lineage: unchanged QD-010 coordinate between first and second limit sessions

execution.entry: first legal executable daily open after completed second upper-limit close, no later than three market sessions

order: highest median annual mean net return
